This Rs. 25,00,000/- was taken by me from Harpal Singh and Jasvir Singh on loan.

(10) That after this we used to call the accused persons again and again and ask them about the progress of the work on which they used to say that your work is still going on and the work will be done soon and like this almost a year passed and when I told them That either you get my work done or return my money on which the accused told that can't you wait for one month or two months, your work is almost done on which I kept silent.

(11) That in June 2019, I got a call from the accused persons who told me that your work is done but I will have to pay the remaining amount of 30 lakhs, and you will arrange the amount and work will be done, whereby I said yes for the sake of saving the large amount which I had earlier given.

(12) That after this, I sold my two Kanals of land under pressure and arranged the amount and I called the accused person on which in October 2019, all the three accused persons came to my house where I handed over Rs. 30,00,000/- in the presence of Sukhjinder Singh numberdar and Gurdeep Singh son of Bava Singh resident of heerke and after taking the amount, the accused persons told me that my work will be done shortly.

(13) That after this, I called many times to the accused persons but they kept on delaying by making some excuse or the other and thereafter,
in March 2020, due to COVID-19 outbreak there was a lockdown abroad; first lingering on the matter on one pretext or other and when I said that if my work is not done then please return my money, then they agreed to return the money.

Then from 21/08/2020 to 22/09/2020, a total of 52,600 was deposited in my account and when I told them that you have returned only 52,000 out of such a huge amount, then they said you should not worry we will get your work done, just let the lockdown be end.

After which the next panchayat meeting was decided to be held at Gurudwara Nabha sahib on 05/03/2023 at 11 AM, after which another meeting was decided to be held at Gurudwara Nabha sahib on 05/03/2 2023 where all the proofs were placed before the accused person in panchayat by me, and there the accused person verbally agreed to pay me 270,00,000/- Lakhs in the Panchayat, but there was nothing in written regarding this and after this, we did not have any panchayat meeting.
That the agreement which was done in Panchayat on dated 21/02/2023 is enclosed here with.
(16) That the agreement entered into by the accused person in panchayat meeting held on 21/02/2023 is attached as evidence.

According to the Panchayat meeting held on 21/02/2023 and on 05/03/2023, in which the accused person promised to pay the amount, but now the accused person refused from the agreement and after which I was forced to give this complaint against the sald accused person to Hon'ble SSP Mohali on 28/03/2023, but no legal election was taken against the said accused person, so it is hereby requested before you that the said accused persons in connivance with each other and on the pretext of settling me in abroad and providing the road contract work under the pretense of making good money, have 4 of 7 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:067439 CRM-M-57885-2023(O&M)
#5# committed fraud of one crore and regarding this, I have call recordings, WhatsApp chat, text messages with accused Swarandeep Singh as a proof the accused person has given me confidence to return my entire amount including the profit and I am attaching call recording, WhatsApp chat, text messages as a proof with this application.

Therefore, Immediate legal action be taken against the said accused persons and case be registered for committing fraud of crore of rupees and Threat being given to kill me and my family, so that in future, this kind of fraud with a person like me cannot be committed with anyone and they can learn a lesson.
Justice should be delivered to me, so that my faith shall remain on law and police administration, I will be very thankful to you.

3. The Counsel for the petitioner contends that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The first inquiry was conducted by the SHO concerned and he had concluded that it was a case of business transaction between the parties and no criminal offence was made out.

However, taking the allegations to be correct, it did not stand to reason that the entire payment was Swarandeep Singh vs State Of Punjab on 14 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29035212/
4 made in cash without any corresponding document being executed.

sentences.text: Be that as it may, as the petitioner was in custody since 03.10.2023, none of the 19 Pws had been examined so far and the case was triable by the court of a Magistrate, he was entitled to the concession of bail.

4. The Counsel for the State on the other hand while referring to the Status report dated 17.02.2024 contends that the petitioner and his co- accused took a huge amount of money on the pretext of sending the complainant abroad.
He was neither send abroad nor was the money refunded to him.
Therefore, the nature of the allegations levelled against the petitioner did not entitle him to the concession of bail.

He however 5 of 7 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:067439 CRM-M-57885-2023(O&M) #6# concedes that the petitioner is in custody since 03.10.2023, none of the 19 Pws had been examined so far and that the case was triable by the court of a Magistrate.
5. The Counsel for the complainant contends that the nature of the allegations levelled against the petitioner did not entitle him to the concession of bail.
6. I have heard learned Counsel for the parties.

7. This Court in the case titled as Maninder Sharma Vs. State Tax Officer, State, Mobile Wing,
Jalandhar, Punjab bearing CRM-M- 24033-2021(O&M) Decided on 31.08.2022 has held as under:-
" Therefore, broadly speaking (subject to any statutory restrictions contained in Special Acts), in economic offences involving the IPC or Special Acts or cases triable by Magistrates once the investigation is complete, final report/complaint filed and the triple test is satisfied then denial of bail must be the exception rather than the rule.

entities.text:
Maninder Sharma Vs. State Tax Officer, State, Mobile Wing,
Jalandhar, Punjab
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
However, this would not prevent the Court from granting bail even prior to the completion of investigation if the facts so warrant."
8.
The veracity of the prosecution case against the petitioner and his co-accused shall be adjudicated upon during the course of the Trial.
Admittedly, the petitioner is in custody since 03.10.2023 but none of the 19 Pws had been examined so far.
Therefore, the Trial of the present case is not likely to be concluded anytime soon.

Further nothing significant has been pointed out by the State that the petitioner would abscond from the Trial, tamper with the evidence or influence the witnesses if he is granted the concession of regular bail.
Therefore, his further incarceration is not required.

9. Thus without commenting on the merits of the case, the present petition is allowed and the petitioner-Swarandeep Singh son of Sh. Sarwan Singh is ordered to be released on bail subject to his furnishing bail bonds 6 of 7 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:067439 CRM-M-57885-2023(O&M)
#7# and surety bonds to the satisfaction of learned CJM/Duty Magistrate, concerned.
10. The petitioner (or anyone on his behalf) shall prepare an FDR in the sum of Rs.2,00,000/- and deposit the same with the Trial Court.
The same would be liable to be forfeited as per law in case of the absence of the petitioner from trial without sufficient cause.

11. The petition stands disposed of.
